name: Proxy decks
description: Decks people share on r/mpcproxies and Ko-fi – real Magic cards with new art and frames – straight from their public Google Drive folders. Free and paid decks are kept apart; add the download link you got after buying a paid one and it opens here too. Print them as real cards of your deck (every picture keeps its maker's credit), save them as a decklist, or save the pictures.
author: MEZTKING
